events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW street activation for eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Dewy Lip Shine product sampling and branded sweet treats while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current NYC event listings independently agree on September 15, 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway and describe the activation as open to the public. No RSVP requirement was established. Samples and treats are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Public walk-in activation on the final day of NYFW. Earlier arrival is preferable if product samples are the priority.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day oversized beauty experience at Gansevoort Plaza tied to Mary Kay's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with product giveaways, beauty touch-ups and interactive photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Mary Kay advertises 10,000 free makeup and skin-care products, plus beauty touch-ups and interactive experiences.
events.caveats: Mary Kay U.S.'s current Eventbrite listing confirms September 15, 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza and promotes 10,000 free makeup and skin-care products. Current NYC listings describe the event as open to the public. Registration is available through the organizer listing; giveaways remain subject to supply/capacity.
events.practical_notes: Use the Mary Kay U.S. Eventbrite registration before traveling. The event is outdoors at Gansevoort Plaza.

events.event_name: National Voter Registration Day NYC Block Party
events.address: Washington Square Park, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: HeadCount's National Voter Registration Day NYC block party with voter-registration assistance, music, art, community activities and brand activations.
events.what_is_free: Free public admission plus brand freebies; verified coverage specifically confirms complimentary Nixie zero-sugar sodas while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current listings and independent coverage agree on September 15, 10 AM–6 PM at Washington Square Park and describe the event as free and open to the public. Brand freebies are while supplies last. Voter registration is offered on site but is not stated as a condition of admission.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public event. Freebie inventory is finite; the park event continues through 6 PM.

events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 2 Herald Square / 1328 Broadway, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A Hempz wellness and body-care pop-up truck outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square centered on the Serene Waters with Magnesium collection.
events.what_is_free: Free magnesium iced teas, iced lavender cold-foam matchas and mini Serene Waters with Magnesium body lotions while supplies last; the first 50 in line are advertised to receive a Calm Kit.
events.caveats: Current listings agree on September 15, 12:30–6:30 PM outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square and describe the pop-up as open to the public. Giveaways and beverages are while supplies last. Some in-store scratch-off outcomes may be purchase-linked; admission and the listed outdoor freebies are not described as purchase-required.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public activation. Arrive near 12:30 PM if the first-50 Calm Kit is the priority.
